sampling.pool: All three archived measurement repeats, with original interleaved loader order; 30000 normal-path rows plus 3000 rows for each fallback path per method before error exclusion.
sampling.matching: Exact fallback reason, then minimum absolute token gap, including ties; error rows excluded. Never replace a missing fallback pool by normal timing.
sampling.rng: SHA256 counter draws with rejection to remove modulo bias; key = protocol seed, method, episode, replicate, matched-pool membership hash, global request index.
sampling.independence: Episode/replicate/method domains are distinct. FV zero and hold share the same domain and potential draw plan.
sampling.pairing_limit: Actual selected rows and clocks remain equal only while feedback visits the same timing path/token pool; divergence is reported, never hidden by mismatched latency substitution.
sampling.correlation: IID sampling destroys temporal correlation and pools three existing trials; it does not generate fresh hardware measurements or identify state-dependent timing.

hold_intervention: At expiration hold current applied command; preserve busy-until-completion, skipped activation, expired-result rejection, and all non-deadline fallback semantics.

statistics.ranking_unit: One replicate is a complete set of 24 fixed episodes for all five methods plus paired FV-hold.
statistics.probabilities: Empirical conditional Monte Carlo proportions across independent replicate draw plans; Wilson 95% intervals quantify simulation sampling precision only.
statistics.distributions: Replicate means and changes relative to the fixed zero-delay baseline; median, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, min/max. Percentile spread is not a confidence interval.
statistics.ties: Costs within 1e-10 are tied; strict reversals exclude ties.
statistics.scope: Conditional on fixed models, fixed 24 episodes, observed timing pools and IID sampler. No inference over new hardware, training seeds, physical plants, or episode population.
statistics.precision: 16 is a pilot budget. Choose at least 64 before launch for tighter Monte Carlo probability precision; neither budget resolves empirical-pool or hardware uncertainty.

reproduction_gate: All 240 original zero-delay/interleaved-replay cases must reproduce before Monte Carlo execution.
scientific_stop_rule: Complete frozen replicate count regardless of signs or rankings; no early stopping or post-outcome enlargement in the same protocol.
